# 2012 Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council Election

## Overview

The 2012 Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on **3 May 2012**, as part of the wider local elections held across England that year. These elections were held on the same day as the London Mayoral and Assembly elections.

## Context

Stockport is a metropolitan borough in Greater Manchester, England. The council uses a system of election by thirds, meaning roughly one-third of council seats are contested each year (with no elections in the fourth year of the cycle). Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council has historically been a stronghold for the **Liberal Democrats**, who had dominated the council for many years, though by this period their support was under significant pressure following the party's entry into the Coalition Government with the Conservatives at national level in 2010.

## Political Background

- The Liberal Democrats had long been the largest party on Stockport Council.
- The formation of the Conservative-Liberal Democrat Coalition Government in 2010 had damaged the Liberal Democrats' support nationally, and local elections in 2011 had seen significant losses for the party across the country.
- **Labour** was making gains across many metropolitan areas during this period, benefiting from anti-government sentiment.

## Results and Outcomes

- **Labour** performed strongly in the 2012 elections, in line with national trends during this period of mid-term unpopularity for the Coalition Government.
- The **Liberal Democrats** suffered losses compared to their previous performances, reflecting the national decline in their support.
- The elections reinforced a broader trend of Labour gains in Greater Manchester and other urban areas.

## Ward-Level Contests

Stockport Borough is divided into multiple wards, and seats across many of these wards were contested. The wards in Stockport include areas such as:

- Bramhall North
- Bramhall South
- Brinnington and Central
- Cheadle and Gatley
- Cheadle Hulme North
- Cheadle Hulme South
- Davenport and Cale Green
- Edgeley and Cheadle Heath
- Heatons North
- Heatons South
- Heaviley
- Marple North
- Marple South
- Manor
- Offerton
- Stepping Hill
- Werneth
